test_cases.description: Verify that the new LVDT Harmonizing Gain is calculated when Primary_Harmonize_Calc is True and Profile_Id is LRU_7.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU operating in Location_State_StateLgc mode; configured as LRU_7 (Rudder).
test_cases.test_inputs: Primary_Harmonize_Calc = True; Profile_Id = LRU_7; Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand = <value> in; Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract = <value> in; Max_Stroke = <value>; LRU Configuration = LRU_7 (Rudder).
test_cases.expected_result: K_Harmonize_New is calculated as Max_Stroke / [Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand – Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract] and is performed.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Verification mechanism to be defined by the verification environment.
